children: Binance has reopened withdrawals for major assets across 15 networks, meeting the Sunday, November 1, target it set after its security incident. In its latest update on X, the exchange added ZEC on the Zcash network, USDT and GRAM on TON, and SUI on Sui to the assets already available.

Withdrawals were already live for BTC; ETH, USDT and USDC on Ethereum; BNB, USDT and USDC on BNB Smart Chain; XRP; ETH and USDC on Base; DOGE; ETH, USDT and USDC on Optimism; ARB, ETH, USDT and USDC on Arbitrum; TRX and USDT on Tron; SOL, USDT and USDC on Solana; POL, USDT and USDC on Polygon; and AVAX, USDT and USDC on Avalanche C-Chain. Binance said it will keep restoring more assets and networks in phases as security checks are completed, with updates shared through its official channels.

title: Binance News Update | Binance Reopens Withdrawals for BTC, ETH, USDT and More Across 15 Networks, Meeting Its Sunday Target
